assertion_scope.fixture_roster: Per O0/O2: 8 manufactured spatial/number/mass arms, two separately initialized RK stages (1 and 3), two generic scalar slots, 768 cell records, 720 boundary records, and procedure call totals [32,32,32,6]. Stage 1 and stage 3 are not a continuous RK trajectory.
assertion_scope.native_procedures: Four verbatim source slices: advect_scalar, rk_update_scalar, rk_update_scalar_pd and flow_dep_bdy_qnn; compiled with a minimal adapter type and stubs, not the full source modules.
assertion_scope.negative_controls: Each optimization rejects missing-cell, wrong-map, wrong-mass, wrong-number, uncleared-source, and wrong-inflow mutations.
assertion_scope.numerical_checks: The independent finite-volume ledger checks order-2 periodic horizontal advection, dry-mass-weighted conservation, prescribed source update, raw-sum discriminator, uniform scalar preservation, source clearing, and boundary inflow/copy/untouched behavior. Relative closure/source guards are fixture-specific checks, not physical accuracy tolerances.
assertion_scope.source_context_pins: v4 pins module_mp_udm, start_em, module_initialize_real and module_first_rk_step_part1 as context. Those files are not extracted or run by this fixture; pinning them does not establish host state wiring.

limits: Four verbatim procedures with minimal config/type/shape adapter; not full modules or a WRF host run.
Order-2 horizontal periodic manufactured fluxes; vertical flux zero, manual periodic halos.
Two generic scalar slots, not Registry-managed QNN/QNC initialization or UDM routing.
Stages 1/3 checked separately with identical prescribed input, not a full RK trajectory.
Source update consumes prescribed mass-coupled tendency; PD advection limiter not executed.
Boundary inflow/outflow/zero velocity and periodic-x suppression are isolated; no complete lateral boundary host trajectory.
Mass-coupled transport behavior does not decide intended UDM stored units or population.
No microphysics, radius, optics, forecast, EOS/balanced atmospheric column or MPI.
scope: Independent static review of the final v4 fixture sources and saved receipt metadata only. No compiler, model, solver, or raw scientific array access by reviewer.

unapproved_host_seam.description: The production chain from driver ccn_conc initialization into QNN, through Registry-managed scalar transport/boundary calls, to the raw NN/NC arrays passed into UDM remains unverified. The fixture uses a manufactured scalar ledger and passes 1.e8 directly as the boundary helper argument; it does not bind its generic slots to QNN/QNC/NN/NC.
